metadata.title: A flux-level Lyman-alpha forest test of a crossing-speed joint between an acceleration law and cold dark energy: frozen criteria, result and blind re-grade (lanes FRZ6 and FRZ6R, 2026-11-13)
metadata.description: Frozen criteria, committed before any script or number, for a test of a candidate rule against the DESI DR1 one-dimensional Lyman-alpha flux power spectrum. The candidate rule lets the acceleration law's layout hold only inside a settled radius and only in haloes slower than a crossing speed fixed by the law and the cosmic baryon share. The constants kappa = 1/2 and 5.41 are fitted, the rule is not adopted, and nothing here says the data favour the framework. Version 2 added the result (FRZ6_RESULT.md: the labels as frozen first, then under a dated post hoc amendment), with the amendment, scripts, part files and graded outputs. Version 3 adds an independent blind re-grade (FRZ6R_RESULT_BLIND.md) with its brief, frozen criteria, amendment, scripts, part files and graded outputs. Read the two result files together: the blind build's frozen label is NO VERDICT, so the first lane's holds remain hits, not confirmed holds.
